title: Urik InGame Menu Supplement for Mutation Mod version
desc:
This is a "supplement" "fix" addon for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=198414240]Urik Game Menu with Rayman's Mutation Mod[/url]
YOU don't need it if you have regular non-mutation "Urik Game Menu".
It can also be used standalone if you desire so.
The reason it is a separate addon is because it didn't work when combined with mutation mod.
This addon contains the custom "in-game pause menu" part of the Game Menu mod.
Please refer to screenshots and description before asking "what does it do?"

Also note that "sliders" in L4D2 don't scale with resolution, so in 2k or 4k they will get much smaller and misaligned with stuff.

I just made this in a couple hours, so report if any bugs as I didn't have the time to fully test it.
I'll maybe add a video later so it's more informative than screenshots.

title: Improved Bots (Advanced)
desc:
[i]This mod has been updated for the Last Stand update![/i]

[h1][b]THIS ADDON REQUIRES ADDITIONAL STEPS TO SET UP![/b][/h1]
After subscribing to this addon, navigate to the location that the game is installed (or right-click the game in your Steam library > [i]properties[/i] > [i]local files[/i] tab > browse local files). From here, open the [i]left4dead2[/i] folder, then the [i]cfg[/i] folder. Now open the [b][i]listenserver.cfg[/i][/b] file (with any text editor, such as Notepad) and copy/paste everything from [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/121071656/135509823663237961/][u]this post[/u][/url] into that file. Save and exit.

Also in that [i]cfg[/i] folder is an [b][i]addonconfig.cfg[/i][/b] file. You'll need to open this file and change the values next to "versus", "scavenge", and "mutation15" to 0 for mods to work in those modes.

When you get in-game go to [b]Options > Keyboard/Mouse > Edit Keys/Buttons[/b], then scroll all the way to the bottom of that menu to find various mod features which you can bind to any key.


[i]The [b]listenserver.cfg[/b] file may need to be updated if this mod is updated. If something doesn't seem to be working try clearing that file then copy/paste everything from that post again.[/i]

[hr]
[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
• Allows you to play versus, survivial, scavenge and realism modes in single player with bots.
• Bots can use melee weapons. [i](Can be toggled)[/i]
• Bots will continue to play after you have died instead of ending the game.
• Bots will react much faster to a player being attacked by a special zombie.
• Bots can perform some simple actions, such as closing safe room doors.
• Bots will move around a player instead of shooting through them.
• Bots are much more likely to save their first aid kits for a player.
• Bots will try to stay in a tighter group with the player.
• Control the bots with a few commands. [b][i](Bind key for this in options menu)[/i][/b]
• Easily change the map and game mode while in-game. [b][i](Bind key for this in options menu)[/i][/b]
• Easily take control of another bot anytime during a game. [b][i](Bind key for this in options menu)[/i][/b]
• Easily change the difficulty of the game at any time. [b][i](Bind key for this in options menu)[/i][/b]
• Teleport bots back to you if they get lost or stuck. [b][i](Bind key for this in options menu)[/i][/b]

[h1][b]Notes[/b][/h1]
• While this addon does improve the bots, it doesn't make them perfect. There is no way for me to fix every issue with the bots, but I have improved them in the areas that are possible. I realize they still aren't ideal teammates.
• Using bot commands will block Steam achievements for the rest of the campaign.
• The bot commands won't work on unofficial maps unless map is started through dev console.
• This version of the addon is ideal for single player.

[hr]
[h1][b]SourceMod Plugins (Optional)[/b][/h1]
Unfortunately, the modding system for this game is very limited. However, installing [url=http://sourcemod.net/downloads.php][u]SourceMod[/u][/url] will allow you to do significantly more with the game than a workshop addon ever could, through additional plugins. SourceMod is intended to be used for servers but can also be used for single player games! Here are some related plugins you may find useful:

• [url=https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=306477][u]200 IQ Bots[/u][/url]
Makes bots keep a safe distance from tanks and startled witches.
• [url=https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=170454][u]AutoHelp[/u][/url]
Help yourself up when incapacitated, rather than relying on the bots to help you.
• [url=https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=261566][u]Defib Using Bots[/u][/url]
Allows bots to use defibrillators to revive you if you die.
• [url=https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?p=1294082][u]Gear Transfer[/u][/url]
Allows bots to pick up throwables and hand them to you when you aren't holding one.
• [url=https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=310638][u]Improved Survivor AI Autotrigger[/u][/url]
Teleports bots or triggers certain events for all bot teams so they can complete all official maps.
• [url=https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=99664][u]Survivor Bot AI Fix[/u][/url]
Increases chances that bots will shoot a special infected that is restraining the player.
• [url=https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?p=1739132][u]Survivor Bot Sniper Rifle AI Fix[/u][/url]
Prevents bots from switching to their secondary weapon when being attacked from close range.
• [url=https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?p=1192594][u]Survivor Bot Takeover[/u][/url]
Automatically take control of a bot when you die.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Ek5NYyxrcs][u]SourceMod install and setup video[/u][/url]

[hr]
[h1][b]Manual Download Sources[/b][/h1]

title: Boomer Peril (Tank Rush mod)
desc: This mutation is like Tank Rush with a twist: There are only boomers at first, but boomer vomit will attract a mob of tanks. The goal: finish without getting vomited (and if you do get vomited, finish without dying). It may sound simple, but as you will see, it's harder than you think. On a scale of 1 to 10 difficulty, this mutation may get a 9/10 difficulty! Play with friends. Not for the faint of heart.

title: Dark Carnival: Remix (2.0 Update)
desc:
[b]Dark Carnival: Remix[/b] is a redesign of Dark Carnival that remakes the layout and adds new areas and events in Whispering Oaks to explore. Beta content has also been brought to life and restored. See the Tunnel of Love with flowing water, the towering Ferris Wheel spinning around, and the explosive Concert finale as it was originally intended. Players in Versus Mode will also have access to new mechanics to create more competitively viable experience. Finally, there's a secret ending cutscene that bridges the gap between Dark Carnival and Swamp Fever if you can find all five secret coins (one on each map)! 

[b]Version 2.0 is now out! Containing a brand new redesign of Map 1 (The Motel), revamps and new areas added to other maps, balance changes for Versus and Coop, and a huge amount of new polish. Please see the pinned thread for the full changelog![/b]

[b]IMPORTANT: If you are spawning outside of the map on Map 2, please disable Population Mods or any other mod that changes the nav. Many of them have not been updated to account for the 2.0 update and they break the map![/b]

title: Tank Rush! Mutation
desc:
No commons, specials, witches. Just plenty of tanks.

Two modes to choose from. Tank Rush! or Tank Rush! Extreme. Tank Rush! features an M60 with infinite ammo whilst Tank Rush! Extreme features the normal weapon spawns with a decreased tank spawn timer.

Kill a tank and heal your entire team. 

Fight to the finale and face waves of tanks before rescue arrives!

Modes: Coop

To launch from lobby: Change Mutation to Tank Rush! or Tank Rush! Extreme and start a new lobby
To launch from console: map mapname tankrush (tankrush2 for Tank Rush! Extreme)

desc:

title: xdReanimsBase (L4D2) Anim Mods base
desc:
[h1]Base dependency for 3-rd person re-animations mods for survivors and infected[/h1]

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Provides basic system of adding replacements for animations.
[*] Slot system that allows combining multiple re-animations mods. Up to 48 different slots per each character.
[*] When not provided new ones, original sequences are played instead. Implement only willing things.
[*] Has sequence orders already predefined for multiplayer gaming consistency, no more of painful sequence reordering for mod makers.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs and Limitations:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Conflicts with other animations mods.
[*] Doesn't alterate hitbox positions on servers without anim mods! Not recommended for competitive playing.
[*] Likewise, with anim mod installed locally, hitboxes locations are not visaully transferred to players without mods.
[*] Combining both mods on same character slot won't work. Random one will be picked instead. Ask modder to recompile to different slot or unpack and move the anim file to another slot, tutorial is in description.
[*] If both mods replace same sequence, the one from replacement with lowest slot number will have priority.
[*] It's currently not possible to replace some animations for stock model variants of some special infected as they have them embedded into models themselves instead of importing from animation mdl and thus having priority. A reanim compatible models of them are required to make them fully moddable.
[*] In stock variants, Francis and Louis have embedded animations. To optionally make them fully moddable, install [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2640924497]Francis[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2640922701]Louis[/url] Reanims Compatible variants or search Reanims Compatible replacement models of them. Without proper support, it's not possible to replace Healing and Rifle animations.
[*] Custom models must have original skeletons.
[*] You can't add new sequences for common zombies, this will break sequences order. You can, however, replace existing. If you need to extend animations with layers, you can replace and use any other -delta or -layer as long as it doesn't break something else.
[*] To replace Tank "Idle" $sequence, have it named as "Idle_xdr".
[/list]

[h2]Info and Guides:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2121557118/2290590708544878869/]How to create reanimation mods[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2121557118/2290590708546536185/]Slots designations[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821354817]Modify xdR animation addons[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3569126360]Animation mod doesn't work or crashes the game[/url] < Read this before commenting.
[/list]

title: Manacat Common Library
desc:
[h1]What is this? and Why?[/h1]
This is a common library package that must be subscribed to in order to properly use add-ons created by Manacat.

Previously, every each addons i made contained the common script parts. but, as the number of addons increased, it became difficult and occur issues to manage by updating every addons whenever the common script was modified, so i separate the common part like this.

[h1]Notes[/h1]
This library aims to maximize the performance assurance of products made by Manacat. And among them are our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3350241824]Extended Stuffs Skin Packs[/url]. Even if you don't use our skin packs anything, this library randomly sets item skins for skin pack users who might join your lobby, and handles some of the functionality related to item acquisition. As such, it may conflict with other scripting functions, and if a conflict is found, I will try to resolve it by primarily, but if it can't, I will do nothing unfortunately. So if you reach mods conflict deadlock, you may need to consider giving up on one side.

[h1]Troubleshooting[/h1]
Even if you have some problem, most of the time it works fine for me. In such cases, I can't help you accurately just by reading a few lines of your comment. I may need your screenshots, video recordings, and streaming to accurately verify the situation. For more active communication, please join [url=https://discord.com/invite/pBDfrxYqJP]my Discord channel.[/url]

title: Admin System
desc:
With the Admin System, you are given Admin control. You can spawn Infected, give Survivors weapons/items, kill/revive Survivors, change Convars, change the timescale, and much, much more!

All of this is done server-side via chat triggers. If you don't have a server, all you need to do is host a Local Server and you should automatically be added as an Admin. If you want to give other players Admin control, you can type "!add_admin nick" if they're playing as Nick, or "!add_admin <playername>" to add their Steam ID to the admins.txt file.

If you have a server, you'll need to manually upload an admins.txt file to your left4dead2/ems/admin system folder. If one doesn't exist, create one.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=213591107]Click here for a complete list of available commands[/url].

Check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=225148475]Admin System Radial Controller[/url] created by jyrka98, for use with the Admin System.

title: Buried Deep [1/2]
desc:
An underground military complex where the survivors were resting was overrun, the only way out is opening a path through the infected.
	 
[h1]Features:[/h1]
 1. 5 Long Maps (Not joking about this one)
 2. Heavy atmosphere for the most part
 3. Also heavy action for certain events
 4. Custom music (See bottom paragraph)
 5. References to movies, series or other games
 6. Le classic easter eggs
 7. Almost everything was made with vanilla assets.

[h1]Story:[/h1]
This campaign is set in an alternate timeline where the APC that rescues the survivors in Blood Harvest takes them to a vast underground Military Research Complex located somewhere beneath the wild mountains of West Virginia. In there, the survivors had 3 days of peace before the infected managed to break through the entire complex. Escaping from the initial invasion wave, the survivors managed to reach some maintenance rooms where they could hide until the outbreak calmed down, where the campaign starts.

[hr][/hr]
	 
This campaign is inspired by alot of things that influenced my level design skills for the past 12 years, this includes other campaigns such as Dark Wood and The Bloody Moors, so expect some heavy atmosphere maps but also some bursts of action in specific events. For a first run i recommend going in Easy or Normal difficulties first since i balanced the campaign for Normal. Advanced and Expert is untested by me, but it is totally doable with certain strategies and coordinated teamwork.

title: Left 4 Bots (Improved A.I.)
desc:
This addon improves the survivor bots behavior to make them more human-like and a bit more useful during the game as well as improving their combat skills.
It is a mix of vanilla AI improvements (via game convars changes) and new features added via vscript.

[h1]Main features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Survivor bots can pick up and use defibrillators
    [*]Survivor bots can pick up throwable items (pipe bomb, bile jar and molotov) and throw them when needed (sometimes they will fu** it up, i warn you lol)
	[*]Survivor bots can pick up and deploy upgrades
	[*]Survivor bots can pick up and use melee weapons and the chainsaw (for M60 and GL you need to add the addon [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2634219419]BOTS T3[/url] or any other similar addon)
	[*]Survivor bots pick up med items more efficiently without waiting for humans to pick them up first (no more medkits left behind)
	[*]Survivor bots can scavenge and pour gascans and deliver cola bottles
	[*]Survivor bots can continue the map by themselves if you die (not all maps). Don't expect them to complete an expert campaign though
	[*]You can play a singleplayer versus match and practice as infected against a full survivor bot team (granted you enables the addons in versus mode in the game's "[b]addonconfig.cfg[/b]" file)
	[*]You can order survivor bots to press buttons, open doors, activate things, pick up weapons, use the minigun (in The Sacrifice finale you can tell them to activate the generators all together so you can get the "Chaos Generator" achievement in singleplayer and you can also send bot Bill to the sacrifice generator for the "Kill Bill" achievement. It is also possible to get the "Sacrifizzle" achievement in singleplayer if you enable addons in versus mode)
	[*]You can order survivor bots to hold their position
	[*]You can order survivor bots to crown a witch
	[*]You can order survivor bots to lead the way to the saferoom (can be useful when playing a custom map for the first time and you can't find the path to the saferoom)
	[*]You can order survivor bots to heal themselves or to heal you or another team member
	[*]You can order survivor bots to throw their nades
	[*]Survivor bots will not heal themselves if they have 50+ HP (like they do in the start saferoom) unless there are enough medkits around for the teammates who need it and the bot to pick up after healing
	[*]Survivor bots will try to dodge the spitted spitter's acid
	[*]Survivor bots will try to shoot and destroy the tank's rock
	[*]Survivor bots react faster, aim better and will try to help more (not always with success though)
	[*]Survivor bots can startle witches (by accidentally shooting them) and set off car alarms just like the human survivors (if you want)
	[*]Survivor bots can give their items to human survivors when they aren't in fight
	[*]Human survivors can give their throwable items to any other survivor just like they do with pills and adrenaline
	[*]Human survivors can swap their throwable items with a survivor bot (you just give them your item to receive theirs back)
	[*]Last survivor bot entering the saferoom immediately closes it
	[*]Other features and more details can be found in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/changelog/2279814689]RELEASE NOTES[/url]
[/list]

You can customize the vscripted features as you like by changing the [url=https://gist.github.com/smilz0/02f7dfe4071505f021e1333ace75aa0a]ADDON SETTINGS[/url] ingame via chat command "!l4bsettings [setting] [value]" or by manually editing the file "[b]Left 4 Dead 2\left4dead2\ems\left4bots\cfg\settings.txt[/b]".
Vanilla AI features are improved via game convars changes (like many other AI improvements do) that are loaded from the file "[b]Left 4 Dead 2\left4dead2\ems\left4bots\cfg\convars.txt[/b]". You can edit this file as you like or you can disable it in the settings.
Bot orders can be issued via [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2279814689/2965019884822668594/]CHAT COMMANDS[/url].
Most commands are also bound to a vocalizer line. You can change the bindings as you like by editing the file "[b]Left 4 Dead 2\left4dead2\ems\left4bots\cfg\vocalizer.txt[/b]".

NOTE: The addon configuration files are re-loaded at the beginning of each map/chapter so you can edit them without the need to restart the game/server.


This addon is fully compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1722866167]LEFT 4 FUN[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2250557219]LEFT 4 GRIEF[/url] and the current version of the Rayman1103's Admin System.
It is also compatible with sourcemod (some plugins may be incompatible though) and most of the other AI improvement addons (the convars ones, like Improved bots (simple), Competitive-bots+ and such. If you use those addons, just disable the L4B convars by setting the "load_convars" setting to "0").


[b][u]PLEASE NOTE: THIS ADDON CANNOT TURN THE BOTS INTO PRO PLAYERS![/u]
The addon does not (it can't) replace the vanilla AI, it just adds features to it.
This means that most of the issues that affect the vanilla AI will probably still be there even with this addon installed.[/b]
Sorry but this is all i can do.


[h1]How to install[/h1]
All you have to do is to subscribe to this addon, subscribe to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2634208272]LEFT 4 LIB[/url] (mandatory) and you are done.
For dedicated servers simply upload the two [b].vpk[/b] files into the server's "[b]Left 4 Dead 2/left4dead2/addons[/b]" directory and the local "[b]admins.txt[/b]" file into the server's "[b]Left 4 Dead 2/left4dead2/ems/left4bots/cfg[/b]" directory (see below).

[h1]How to add admins[/h1]
Depending on the settings, only admins may be able to give orders to the bots.
Once installed, the first time you run the game (local server or singleplayer) you will be recognized as the host and automatically added to the file "[b]Left 4 Dead 2\left4dead2\ems\left4bots\cfg\admins.txt[/b]".
You can add other admins by adding lines to the file, just make sure each line is in the format "[b]STEAMID //NAME[/b]".

NOTE: The steam id can be found with any steam id finder websites on the internet and it's the one with this format: [b]STEAM_x:x:xxxxxxxx[/b]. The ID usually starts with "[b]STEAM_0[/b]", if that doesn't work just change the first 0 to 1 [b]STEAM_1[/b] (don't touch the rest).

title: Bhop Journey
desc:
[h1] Description [/h1]

[b] Bhop Journey by Arzeval [/b]

Most Valve games have their own unique jumping mechanics along with their jumping community and a dozen maps. but when it comes to Left 4 Dead 2, there are barely any maps made for bunnyhoping, so I decided to give it a try and create this map!

Bhop Journey is a challenge bhop map made for players who are already familiar with the basic bunny hoping, difficulty start from somewhat easy to very hard.  every section of the map has been tested many times and it's all possible with or without using autobhop!

[h1] Notes [/h1]

[*][b] This is a challenge  map for players who are already experienced with bhop.[/b]

[*] [b] Blue Platforms[/b] are designed for Normal bhop (none crouch), and its recommended to not use crouch on them to avoid overjumps
[b] White Platforms[/b] are designed for Crouch bhop

[*] [b] Blue boost Platforms [/b] will require you to bhop on them or to press jump as soon as you interact with them to give you enough speed while
[b]Orange boost Platforms[/b] will give you enough speed and do not require any bhop



[*][b] first 2 levels of nightmare section might not be possible with high ping (100+).[/b]



for a better visual experience:
   [*] [b] Set your brightness to 2.1  [/b]
   [*] [b] If possible make sure your graphic options are set at least to high settings [/b]





[h1] Sections [/h1]

Easy  [11 Levels] 
Medium [10  Levels]
Hard  [8 Levels]
Nightmare  [3 Levels]

There's also 2 secret rooms located on Easy and Medium sections 



Many thanks to ᴿᴱᴻᴱ™ and everyone else who tested and helped me out with this map

Enjoy!

title: Buried Deep [2/2]
desc:
An underground military complex where the survivors were resting was overrun, the only way out is opening a path through the infected.
	 
[h1]Features:[/h1]
 1. 5 Long Maps (Not joking about this one)
 2. Heavy atmosphere for the most part
 3. Also heavy action for certain events
 4. Custom music (See bottom paragraph)
 5. References to movies, series or other games
 6. Le classic easter eggs
 7. Almost everything was made with vanilla assets.

[h1]Story:[/h1]
This campaign is set in an alternate timeline where the APC that rescues the survivors in Blood Harvest takes them to a vast underground Military Research Complex located somewhere beneath the wild mountains of West Virginia. In there, the survivors had 3 days of peace before the infected managed to break through the entire complex. Escaping from the initial invasion wave, the survivors managed to reach some maintenance rooms where they could hide until the outbreak calmed down, where the campaign starts.

[hr][/hr]
	 
This campaign is inspired by alot of things that influenced my level design skills for the past 12 years, this includes other campaigns such as Dark Wood and The Bloody Moors, so expect some heavy atmosphere maps but also some bursts of action in specific events. For a first run i recommend going in Easy or Normal difficulties first since i balanced the campaign for Normal. Advanced and Expert is untested by me, but it is totally doable with certain strategies and coordinated teamwork.
	 
Most of the custom music used comes from Hellgate London, except for the mega events of the third and fourth map, and the outro music, those respectively are:
[b]Elevator Event:[/b] (Bloodshot OST) Steve Jablonsky - The Tunnel
[b]Gates Event:[/b] (The Maze Runner Scorch Trials OST) John Paesano - Lights
[b]Outro:[/b] Nine Inch Nails - Only (Triptych remix by MoozE)
[b]Zombat:[/b] Two Steps From Hell - Norwegian Devil

title: Left 4 Lib
desc:
This addon contains some shared VScript code that is used by my addons:
[list]
    [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2279814689]Left 4 Bots[/url]
    [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1722866167]Left 4 Fun[/url]
    [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2250557219]Left 4 Grief[/url]
[/list]

[b][i]This addon is mandatory if you have one of the addons listed above. They will not work without this![/i][/b]


[h1]Centralized User System[/h1]
L4L also contains a centralized user system that is shared among all my addons.
The system automatically assigns a user level to the joining player. The other addons will use this level to give/restrict access to certain features to that player.

The L4U user levels are:
[list]
    [*]Admin
    [*]Friend
    [*]User
    [*]Griefer
[/list]
When you first host a local game with this and one of my other addons (Left 4 Fun, Left 4 Bots, Left 4 Lib), you (the host) are automatically added as admin and you will be admin on all the addons.

You can add other admins by editing the file 'ems/left4lib/cfg/admins.txt' or directly ingame with the following commands:
[list]
    [*]Via chat: !l4u add [player/character name] admin
    [*]Via console: scripted_user_func l4u,add,[player/character name],admin
[/list]
Remove the admin with:
[list]
    [*]Via chat: !l4u remove [player/character name]
    [*]Via console: scripted_user_func l4u,remove,[player/character name]
[/list]
At the same way you can assign a Friend or Griefer level to a player:
[list]
    [*]Via chat: !l4u add [player/character name] [friend/griefer]
    [*]Via console: scripted_user_func l4u,add,[player/character name],[friend/griefer]
[/list]
And you can remove the assigned level the same way you remove admins.

The Friend and Griefer lists are saved into the files 'ems/left4lib/cfg/friends.txt' and 'ems/left4lib/cfg/griefers.txt'.
The players who do not belong to any of these lists are automatically given the normal User level.


[h1]Addon settings[/h1]

L4L also has its own settings. You can find more details [url=https://github.com/smilz0/Left4Lib/blob/main/root/scripts/vscripts/left4lib_settings.nut]HERE[/url].

Some of these settings (like hooks_chatcommand_trigger) affect all the addons that use this library.

You can change the settings by editing the file 'ems/left4lib/cfg/settings.txt'.


[h1]Compatibility[/h1]

This should be fully compatible with any Admin System/VSLib version and most addons in general.


[h1]Are you a L4D2 modder?[/h1]

You are free to use the features contained in this addon, if you want to. Technical details can be found in the form of comments inside the .nut files.
Only one thing i ask you: please, do not put the L4L files in your addon but consider referencing L4L as an external required addon like i do in L4F, L4B and L4G. Reason for this is that by duplicating this library you will create multiple versions of it making the addons using the library incompatible with each other.

More info can be found on the [url=https://github.com/smilz0/Left4Lib]L4L GitHub Repository[/url].

title: Improved Hunter AI
desc:
[h1]If you can't hunt, you will be hunted.[/h1]
This add-on improves the Hunter's AI to a level that is more threatening to survivors.
The major changes are as follows.

 - Prevents claw attacks from shoved Hunters
 - When the Hunter pounces a survivor, nearby survivors will stumble.
 - If pounced by a Hunter who has fallen from a high place, will receive extra damage.
 - The delay between the Hunter's leap and leap is reduced.
 - Hunters who have been shoved back recover quickly.
 - Hunters perform a deception/evasion leap when they are clearly aware that they are being targeted.
 - Hunters can step on walls and leap again.
 - Hunter's flee leap is converted into a pounce leap.

[h1]Customize the Hunters' Behavior with Simple Commands As You Like.[/h1]
[code][h3]chat command[/h3]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]!hunter
(or !h)[/th]
        [th]Shows current Hunter AI settings.[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]!hunter jump[/th]
        [th]Adjust hunter jump (wall jump / interval)
0 = Wall jump Ｘ, Long jump interval (Default)
1 = Wall jump Ｏ, Short jump interval
2 = Wall jump Ｏ, Shortest jump interval[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]!hunter roll[/th]
        [th]If disturbed when pounced, rolled off and recover posture quickly[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]!hunter feint[/th]
        [th]If feel in danger, feint leap to confuse[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]!hunter cull[/th]
        [th]Cull jump automatically changes to pounce jump[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]!hunter stagger[/th]
        [th]Adjust hunter stagger when shoved
0 = Long stagger (6s, Default)
1 = Short stagger (3s)
2 = Shortest stagger (1s)[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]!hunter stumble[/th]
        [th]When pounced, nearby survivors stumble[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]!hunter dist[/th]
        [th]Extra pounce damage based on leap distance and height[/th]
